title: Online Sparse Regression with Expanding Observables
summary: Online high-dimensional regression has gained increasing attention in recent years, yet existing methods typically assume that all candidate features, including important ones, are observed from the outset of data collection. This assumption is often violated in real-world scenarios, where new variables become available gradually as data accumulate. To address this gap, we introduce a novel framework, Recurrent Adaptive Variable Selection (RAVAS), for online regression with expanding observability.
